@@ -0,0 +1,235 @@
+# Blackjack Simulator, Strategy Trainer & Monte Carlo CLI — Implementation Plan
+
+Go 1.26+, standard library only. Module name: `blackjack`.
+
+## 1. Package Layout
+
+```
+go.mod
+main.go                     # thin CLI entrypoint: flag parsing, dispatch
+main_test.go                # tests for flag parsing / dispatch helpers
+internal/
+  deck/
+    card.go                 # Suit, Rank, Card, Value(), String()
+    shoe.go                 # Shoe (1–8 decks), Fisher-Yates, cut card
+    deck_test.go
+  game/
+    hand.go                 # Hand, Total() with dynamic aces, IsBust/IsBlackjack/IsPair
+    rules.go                # Rules struct (S17, 3:2, split/double rules), Action, Outcome
+    round.go                # Round: deal, player actions, dealer play, settlement
+    game_test.go
+  strategy/
+    tables.go               # hard / soft / pair matrices (S17, multi-deck, DAS)
+    strategy.go             # Recommend(hand, dealerUp, canDouble, canSplit) Action
+    strategy_test.go
+  ui/
+    render.go               # ANSI card rendering, hand rendering, table status, money fmt
+    render_test.go
+  sim/
+    sim.go                  # Monte Carlo runner using strategy.Recommend; Stats + Summary()
+    sim_test.go
+  play/
+    play.go                 # interactive loop over io.Reader / io.Writer (testable)
+    play_test.go
+```
+
+Rationale: `main.go` stays minimal so the testable logic lives in packages, keeping
+`go test -cover ./...` ≥ 80 % overall.
+
+## 2. Package Design
+
+### 2.1 `internal/deck`
+
+```go
+type Suit int   // Spades, Hearts, Diamonds, Clubs
+type Rank int   // Ace=1, Two..Ten=2..10, Jack=11, Queen=12, King=13
+
+type Card struct { Suit Suit; Rank Rank }
+func (c Card) Value() int        // Ace→11, J/Q/K→10, others face value
+func (c Card) IsAce() bool
+func (c Card) String() string    // "A♥", "10♠", "K♦"
+func (s Suit) String() string    // "♠" "♥" "♦" "♣"
+func (r Rank) String() string    // "A","2".."10","J","Q","K"
+
+type Shoe struct {
+    cards    []Card
+    pos      int
+    numDecks int
+    cutIndex int
+    rng      *rand.Rand
+}
+func NewShoe(numDecks int, penetration float64, rng *rand.Rand) (*Shoe, error)
+    // numDecks must be 1..8; penetration in (0,1], default 0.75 if 0
+    // builds 52*numDecks cards, shuffles, sets cutIndex = int(len*penetration)
+func (s *Shoe) Shuffle()            // Fisher-Yates in place, pos = 0
+func (s *Shoe) Draw() (Card, error) // ErrShoeEmpty if exhausted
+func (s *Shoe) NeedsShuffle() bool  // pos >= cutIndex
+func (s *Shoe) Remaining() int
+func (s *Shoe) NumDecks() int
+```
+
+Fisher-Yates: `for i := n-1; i > 0; i-- { j := rng.IntN(i+1); swap(i,j) }`.
+`math/rand/v2` with injectable `*rand.Rand` for determinism in tests.
+
+Tests: card values (all 52 unique per deck), shoe size for 1–8 decks, error on 0/9,
+shuffle is a permutation (multiset preserved), deterministic with seed, NeedsShuffle
+flips at cut card, Draw past end returns error.
+
+### 2.2 `internal/game`
+
+```go
+type Action int   // Hit, Stand, Double, Split
+func (a Action) String() string
+
+type Outcome int  // Win, Loss, Push, Blackjack (natural win)
+
+type Rules struct {
+    DealerHitsSoft17  bool    // false → S17 (default)
+    BlackjackPayout   float64 // 1.5 (3:2)
+    MaxSplitHands     int     // 2 (spec: split into 2 active hands)
+    DoubleAfterSplit  bool    // true
+    MinBet, MaxBet    int     // 10, 500
+}
+func DefaultRules() Rules
+
+type Hand struct {
+    Cards     []deck.Card
+    Bet       int
+    Doubled   bool
+    FromSplit bool
+    Done      bool   // stood / busted / doubled / 21
+}
+func (h *Hand) Add(c deck.Card)
+func (h Hand) Total() (total int, soft bool)  // aces 11 → 1 while total > 21
+func (h Hand) IsBust() bool
+func (h Hand) IsBlackjack() bool  // 2 cards, 21, !FromSplit
+func (h Hand) IsPair() bool       // 2 cards, same Rank (10/J/Q/K treated as same value? -> same Value())
+func (h Hand) CanDouble(r Rules) bool
+func (h Hand) CanSplit(r Rules, numHands int) bool
+func (h Hand) Describe() string   // "Soft 21", "Hard 16", "Bust", "Blackjack"
+
+type Round struct {
+    Rules   Rules
+    Shoe    *deck.Shoe
+    Dealer  Hand
+    Hands   []*Hand
+    Active  int        // index into Hands, -1 when player phase over
+}
+func NewRound(shoe *deck.Shoe, rules Rules, bet int) (*Round, error)
+    // deals P, D, P, D; validates bet range; marks player done if natural
+func (r *Round) CurrentHand() *Hand
+func (r *Round) PlayerTurnOver() bool
+func (r *Round) Apply(a Action) error  // Hit/Stand/Double/Split; advances Active
+func (r *Round) PlayDealer()           // skip if all player hands bust; hit <17 or soft17 if H17
+func (r *Round) Settle() []Result      // per-hand Outcome + Payout (net int)
+
+type Result struct { Hand *Hand; Outcome Outcome; Net int }
+```
+
+Payout: Blackjack → +bet*1.5 (int math: bet*3/2), win → +bet (doubled = 2×bet),
+loss → −bet, push → 0. Dealer natural vs player natural → push.
+Split aces: one card each, auto-stand (standard rule). Split hands cannot be blackjack.
+
+Tests: soft/hard totals (A+6=soft 17, A+6+10=hard 17, A+A=soft 12), bust detection,
+blackjack detection, pair detection, double/split eligibility, full round via a
+scripted shoe (a `deck.Shoe` built from a fixed card order — add
+`deck.NewShoeFromCards([]Card)` helper for tests), dealer S17 stands, settlement for
+each outcome incl. 3:2 payout and doubled bets, split flow to two hands.
+
+### 2.3 `internal/strategy`
+
+Basic Strategy for multi-deck, S17, DAS. Encode as rune matrices indexed by
+[total][dealerUp 2..11]:
+
+- `H` hit, `S` stand, `D` double else hit, `d` double else stand, `P` split.
+
+Hard 5–8: H. Hard 9: D vs 3–6 else H. Hard 10: D vs 2–9. Hard 11: D vs 2–10, H vs A.
+Hard 12: S vs 4–6. Hard 13–16: S vs 2–6. Hard 17+: S.
+Soft 13–14: D vs 5–6. Soft 15–16: D vs 4–6. Soft 17: D vs 3–6. Soft 18: d vs 2–6,
+S vs 7–8, H vs 9–A. Soft 19+: S.
+Pairs: A,A & 8,8: P always. 10,10: S. 9,9: P except 7,10,A. 7,7: P vs 2–7.
+6,6: P vs 2–6. 5,5: treat as hard 10. 4,4: P vs 5–6. 2,2/3,3: P vs 2–7.
+
+```go
+func Recommend(h game.Hand, dealerUp deck.Card, canDouble, canSplit bool) game.Action
+```
+Falls back: Double disallowed → Hit (D) or Stand (d); Split disallowed → hard/soft table.
+
+Tests: table-driven cases for each region; fallback behaviour; full matrix sanity
+(every cell yields a valid action); dealer upcard A maps to column 11.
+
+### 2.4 `internal/ui`
+
+```go
+func RenderCard(c deck.Card) string            // "[ 10♠ ]" / "[  A♥ ]" (red for ♥♦ when color on)
+func RenderHidden() string                     // "[ ?? ]"
+func RenderHand(h game.Hand, hideHole bool) string // cards + " (Soft 21)"
+func FormatMoney(n int) string                 // "$1,000", "-$250"
+func RenderTable(w io.Writer, bankroll, bet int, r *game.Round, hideHole bool)
+func SetColor(enabled bool)                    // disable ANSI in tests / sim
+```
+
+Tests: card padding, soft/hard suffix, money formatting, hidden hole card, table
+output contains bankroll/bet/upcard.
+
+### 2.5 `internal/sim`
+
+```go
+type Config struct { Rounds, Decks, Bet int; Seed uint64; Rules game.Rules }
+type Stats struct {
+    Rounds, Hands, Wins, Losses, Pushes, Blackjacks int
+    TotalWagered, Net int
+    Duration time.Duration
+}
+func Run(cfg Config) (Stats, error)   // reshuffles at cut card; plays all hands via strategy.Recommend
+func (s Stats) WinPct()/LossPct()/PushPct()/EVPct() float64   // EV% = Net/TotalWagered*100
+func (s Stats) Summary() string       // formatted table
+```
+
+Tests: run 1,000 rounds with seed → counts sum correctly, percentages sum ≈100,
+EV within plausible range (−5 % … +3 %), Summary contains headers, deterministic
+across identical seeds.
+
+### 2.6 `internal/play`
+
+```go
+type Options struct { Hint bool; Decks int; Bankroll int; Seed uint64; Rules game.Rules }
+func Run(in io.Reader, out io.Writer, opts Options) error
+```
+Loop: prompt bet (10–500, ≤ bankroll, `q` to quit) → deal → for each active hand show
+table, (hint if enabled), prompt `[h]it [s]tand [d]ouble [p]split` honoring
+eligibility → dealer plays → settle, update bankroll → repeat until quit or broke.
+
+Tests: scripted stdin (`strings.NewReader`) covering bet validation, each action,
+hint output, quit, bust bankroll end.
+
+### 2.7 `main.go`
+
+Flags: `-sim`, `-n` (default 10000), `-hint`, `-decks` (default 6), `-seed`,
+`-bet` (sim bet, default 10), `-no-color`.
+`run(args []string, in io.Reader, out io.Writer) int` is tested in `main_test.go`;
+`main()` just calls `os.Exit(run(...))`.
+
+## 3. Flow
+
+```mermaid
+flowchart TD
+    A[main.go parse flags] -->|sim| B[sim.Run]
+    A -->|play| C[play.Run]
+    B --> D[deck.Shoe]
+    C --> D
+    B --> E[game.Round]
+    C --> E
+    B --> F[strategy.Recommend]
+    C -->|hint| F
+    C --> G[ui.RenderTable]
+    E --> D
+```
+
+## 4. Verification Gate
+
+1. `go build ./...` and `go vet ./...` clean.
+2. `go test -v -cover ./...` all pass, every package ≥ 80 %, overall ≥ 80 %.
+3. `go test -race ./...` passes.
+4. `go run main.go -sim -n 10000` prints summary with W/L/P %, EV %, duration.
+5. `go run main.go --hint` starts interactive mode (smoke-check via piped stdin).

+// Package deck provides playing cards and a multi-deck blackjack shoe.
+package deck
+
+import "fmt"
+
+// Suit is one of the four French suits.
+type Suit int
+
+// Suit constants.
+const (
+	Spades Suit = iota
+	Hearts
+	Diamonds
+	Clubs
+)
+
+// Suits lists all suits in canonical order.
+var Suits = [...]Suit{Spades, Hearts, Diamonds, Clubs}
+
+// String returns the Unicode symbol for the suit.
+func (s Suit) String() string {
+	switch s {
+	case Spades:
+		return "♠"
+	case Hearts:
+		return "♥"
+	case Diamonds:
+		return "♦"
+	case Clubs:
+		return "♣"
+	default:
+		return "?"
+	}
+}
+
+// IsRed reports whether the suit is traditionally printed in red.
+func (s Suit) IsRed() bool {
+	return s == Hearts || s == Diamonds
+}
+
+// Rank is the face rank of a card: Ace=1, Two..Ten=2..10, Jack=11, Queen=12, King=13.
+type Rank int
+
+// Rank constants.
+const (
+	Ace Rank = iota + 1
+	Two
+	Three
+	Four
+	Five
+	Six
+	Seven
+	Eight
+	Nine
+	Ten
+	Jack
+	Queen
+	King
+)
+
+// Ranks lists all ranks in ascending order.
+var Ranks = [...]Rank{Ace, Two, Three, Four, Five, Six, Seven, Eight, Nine, Ten, Jack, Queen, King}
+
+// String returns the short label for the rank ("A", "2".."10", "J", "Q", "K").
+func (r Rank) String() string {
+	switch {
+	case r == Ace:
+		return "A"
+	case r >= Two && r <= Ten:
+		return fmt.Sprintf("%d", int(r))
+	case r == Jack:
+		return "J"
+	case r == Queen:
+		return "Q"
+	case r == King:
+		return "K"
+	default:
+		return "?"
+	}
+}
+
+// Card is a single playing card.
+type Card struct {
+	Suit Suit
+	Rank Rank
+}
+
+// Value returns the blackjack value of the card. Aces count as 11 here;
+// hand evaluation is responsible for demoting aces to 1 when needed.
+func (c Card) Value() int {
+	switch {
+	case c.Rank == Ace:
+		return 11
+	case c.Rank >= Ten:
+		return 10
+	default:
+		return int(c.Rank)
+	}
+}
+
+// IsAce reports whether the card is an ace.
+func (c Card) IsAce() bool {
+	return c.Rank == Ace
+}
+
+// String renders the card compactly, e.g. "A♥" or "10♠".
+func (c Card) String() string {
+	return c.Rank.String() + c.Suit.String()
+}

+// Package game implements blackjack hand evaluation, standard casino rules and
+// the round state machine (deal → player actions → dealer play → settlement).
+package game
+
+// Action is a player decision.
+type Action int
+
+// Player actions.
+const (
+	Hit Action = iota
+	Stand
+	Double
+	Split
+)
+
+// String returns the human readable action name.
+func (a Action) String() string {
+	switch a {
+	case Hit:
+		return "Hit"
+	case Stand:
+		return "Stand"
+	case Double:
+		return "Double"
+	case Split:
+		return "Split"
+	default:
+		return "Unknown"
+	}
+}
+
+// Outcome is the result of a single player hand against the dealer.
+type Outcome int
+
+// Hand outcomes.
+const (
+	Loss Outcome = iota
+	Push
+	Win
+	Blackjack // natural 21 paid at Rules.BlackjackPayout
+)
+
+// String returns the human readable outcome name.
+func (o Outcome) String() string {
+	switch o {
+	case Loss:
+		return "Loss"
+	case Push:
+		return "Push"
+	case Win:
+		return "Win"
+	case Blackjack:
+		return "Blackjack"
+	default:
+		return "Unknown"
+	}
+}
+
+// Rules configures table rules.
+type Rules struct {
+	// DealerHitsSoft17 selects H17 when true. Default (false) is S17.
+	DealerHitsSoft17 bool
+	// BlackjackPayout is the multiplier paid on a natural (1.5 == 3:2).
+	BlackjackPayout float64
+	// MaxSplitHands is the maximum number of hands a player may hold after splitting.
+	MaxSplitHands int
+	// DoubleAfterSplit allows doubling on hands produced by a split.
+	DoubleAfterSplit bool
+	// MinBet and MaxBet bound the wager for a round.
+	MinBet int
+	MaxBet int
+}
+
+// DefaultRules returns standard rules: S17, 3:2 naturals, split into two
+// hands, double after split allowed, bets $10–$500.
+func DefaultRules() Rules {
+	return Rules{
+		DealerHitsSoft17: false,
+		BlackjackPayout:  1.5,
+		MaxSplitHands:    2,
+		DoubleAfterSplit: true,
+		MinBet:           10,
+		MaxBet:           500,
+	}
+}
+
+// BlackjackWinnings returns the net amount won on a natural for the given bet.
+func (r Rules) BlackjackWinnings(bet int) int {
+	return int(float64(bet) * r.BlackjackPayout)
+}
